about.title: About Mini Games
about.subtitle: A passion for games, a platform for everyone
about.mission_p1: Mini Games was born from a simple passion: creating fun and accessible games for everyone. We believe the best gaming moments are those we share, whether for a few minutes of relaxation or hours of challenge.
about.mission_p2: Each game is carefully designed to offer a unique, addictive and completely free experience. No invasive ads, no pay-to-win, just pure gaming fun.
about.timeline_jan: Launch of Mini Games with our first two games: Snow Digger and Morpion. The beginning of a passionate adventure around mini‑games.
about.timeline_feb: New games added: casino, funfair, exploration, puzzle and introduction of multiplayer mode with a rooms system in the exploration game LostBelow. The platform is growing fast.
about.timeline_mar:
Major expansion with the arrival of: Block Puzzle, Battleship, Layer Pile, Draw and Guess, Falling Blocks, Lights Out Reflex and GeoQuiz.
The experience becomes immersive with the integration of sounds and music, as well as the arrival of world records to challenge the community.
The platform reaches a new milestone!
about.timeline_apr:
Arrival of Where Am I and Punch Reflex, plus enrichment of Block Puzzle with new pieces.
Complete redesign of game cards and menu with a category system. Music now pauses automatically when the page is hidden.
Launch of Rocketeer — build your rocket and launch it into space!
First steps toward multilingual support across the platform.
about.timeline_ongoing: Rolling out multilingual support across all games on the platform. We're also working on new games and continuing to optimize the mobile experience.
about.timeline_soon: Launch of a personalized profiles system, daily challenges with rewards and expansion of real-time multiplayer to our classics. The Mini‑Games adventure is just getting started!
about.tech_intro: All our games are built with modern web technologies to ensure optimal performance on all devices.
about.contact_p: A bug to report? A suggestion? Feel free to contact us!

manual.page1_content:
Drag parts from the catalog. They snap to connection nodes.

  • Core: Every rocket needs a Cockpit, Fuel, and Engine.
  • Staging: Use Decouplers to drop empty tanks and ignite the next phase.
  • TWR: Thrust-to-Weight Ratio must be > 1.0 to lift off.
manual.page2_content:
• Shift / Ctrl Throttle Control
  • Space Next Stage / Decouple
  • T Cycle Time Scale (1x, 2x, 4x, 8x, 15x)
  • C Center Camera
  • Note: Manual rotation is disabled. Balancing is done via design!
manual.page3_content:
• Distance: 1¢ per 100m reached.
  • Speed Bonus: Faster missions earn up to +10% extra!
  • Milestones: Massive grants for reaching 100km, 500km, etc.
  • R&D: Spend credits to improve ISP, Thrust, and Science.
manual.page4_content:
• Torque: If thrust is off-center from the Center of Mass (CoM), the rocket will tilt.
  • Aerodynamics: Air density drops with altitude. Fins help stabilize in low atmosphere.
  • Heat: High-speed descent in atmosphere is dangerous!
